prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 15 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1314; do not mention it.)
text:
Clinical Treatment Summary

The patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection with pain and swelling of the left wrist. Imaging confirmed a distal radius fracture with mild displacement. Closed reduction was performed under local anesthesia, and the wrist was immobilized in a long-arm cast for six weeks. Neurovascular status was monitored at each visit and remained intact throughout the course of care.

Over the subsequent months the patient attended fifteen outpatient visits, including orthopedic follow-up, radiographic reassessment, and hand therapy sessions. Serial X-rays demonstrated satisfactory alignment and progressive callus formation. Following cast removal, the patient began a structured range-of-motion and grip-strengthening program. Initial stiffness and mild discomfort with lifting improved steadily over the course of therapy.

At the most recent evaluation, the patient reported significant functional improvement, with near-full wrist flexion and extension and grip strength approaching the contralateral side. Residual intermittent aching is noted with heavy exertion. Continued home exercises and activity modification are recommended, with follow-up as needed.
